{"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=structural+conditions+for+operationalizing+AI+agency+and+decision+consequence+accountability&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Teaching Craft Intelligence: Sovereignty Protocols for AI-Mediated Student Leadership.\", \"abstract\": \"Artificial intelligence (AI) now mediates how student leaders learn and decide, creating a speed imperative that often rewards algorithmic fluency over human judgment and intercultural accountability. This article argues student leadership programs can turn AI from a plagiarism risk into a laboratory for craft intelligence (transforming knowledge and lived experience into sound judgment in action) and deliberate stewardship, which safeguards how knowledge is created, tested, and shared. It maps four perils (e.g., inquiry collapse, context erasure, algorithmic authority, and cultural narrowing) that introduces a Trace of Agency toolkit of four sovereignty protocols to make AI-assisted decisions transparent and leadership claims auditable.\", \"doi\": \"10.1002/yd.70070\", \"pmid\": \"42753193\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13603953\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.1002/yd.70070\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13603953\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13603953?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"Synthetic gatekeeping in health chatbots: configured answer systems as the unit of AI evaluation and governance for medical information.\", \"abstract\": \"Two health chatbots can give the same clinically appropriate advice and still constitute different interventions: one stops at a clinician referral, the other places an affiliated booking one click away.
